title: Official transcript for a current student
description: This document workflow is for currently enrolled students; alumni use a separate service.
descriptionAr: هذه الخدمة للطلبة المسجلين حالياً، وللخريجين خدمة منفصلة.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. The document service does not give this chatbot access to the private transcript.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: The document service does not give this chatbot access to the private transcript.

steps.title: Open Current Students Documents
steps.instruction: Open Current Students Documents: sign in through the official UAEU portal or app and choose the document service.
steps.instructionAr: افتح وثائق الطلبة الحاليين: سجل الدخول عبر بوابة الجامعة أو تطبيقها الرسمي واختر خدمة الوثائق.

steps.title: Select the transcript
steps.instruction: Select the transcript: choose Academic Transcript Arabic or Academic Transcript English, then submit the request.
steps.instructionAr: حدد كشف الدرجات: اختر كشف الدرجات بالعربية أو بالإنجليزية ثم أرسل الطلب.

steps.title: Track delivery
steps.instruction: Track delivery: use My Requests and check your university email for the processed document.
steps.instructionAr: تابع التسليم: استخدم My Requests وتحقق من بريدك الجامعي لاستلام الوثيقة بعد المعالجة.

sources.title: UAEU Current Students Documents Service
sources.evidenceText: For currently enrolled students, Current Students Documents is accessed through the official UAEU portal or app with UAE Pass or university credentials. Choose Academic Transcript Arabic or Academic Transcript English, then submit the request. This is the current-student service, distinct from alumni documents.

sources.title: UAEU Current Students Documents User Guide
sources.sourceSection: Pages 4–6: document selection, My Requests and university-email delivery
sources.evidenceText: The official2026 Current Students Documents User Guide, pages4–6, describes selecting the requested document, submitting it, tracking it in My Requests and receiving the processed document at the university email address. This source establishes these document-delivery steps, not a service fee or delivery-time guarantee.
